## Observations

- A request with a made-up Mcp-Session-Id gets status 400.
- GET /mcp answers 405; DELETE and session features aren't used, the server is stateless.
- Cloudflare answers a default Python-urllib User-Agent with status 403 (blocked before it reaches the server). An agent scripting the server from Python must set its own User-Agent. The suite uses the real .NET MCP client.
- The anonymous tool list is 7,279 characters of JSON, what an agent pays to load it.
- An unindexed scan of ItemStat took 134 ms and finished.
- patch-D's Spell.dbc has 239’067 rows; 207’627 of its ids are also in the default winner, 31’440 are only in patch-D.
- No DBC table is won by a project-built archive, so the dbc layer holds no base copies.
- dbc_rows says "in row order", and with a unique numeric first column that means key order, not the file's record order: reading by offset walks the rows sorted by id. No value is wrong, but a reader counting file records would be off.
- DBC rows: 100 rows, 4304 field values and 188 non-empty strings compared across 25 tables.
- Paths: 110 answers from client_paths and 22 from get(path:...) compared with the manifest.
- 770,946 archive entries had their names re-hashed locally with this suite's MPQ hash.
- 110 field config files exist. Status: "110 tables with proven field names".
- search for "' OR 1=1 --" gives 44 hits, treated as the plain words it holds.
- Through Cloudflare: 120 requests were allowed in 1.2 s before the first 429 (limit 120 a minute).
- A 429 from the server has no Retry-After header, so a client has to guess when to try again (a minute is always enough).
- Spoofed headers through Cloudflare while limited, one header at a time and all at once: statuses 429,429,429,403,403,429,429,429,403,403,429,429 (403 is Cloudflare refusing a forged header, 429 is the server's limit).
- This machine's status right after the second client's run: 429. Second client: 200,200,200,200,200,200,200,200,200,200.
- A direct request to the origin, under the public host name, gets status 200. The proxy serves it, so the limit must hold here too.
- Direct to the origin with a different forged CF-Connecting-IP and X-Forwarded-For on every request: 119 requests were allowed in 0.6 s before the first 429.
- At saturation: 3 bursts of 24 slow reads from this machine got 200 x24, 429 x48.
- The credential "non-ASCII token" gets HTTP 400 when connecting, for reads as well: it's stopped before the server's own reads-still-work rule applies.
- Live update: 79 concurrent reads ran across the publish and rollback, 0 failed. Versions seen by the readers, in order: 20261104030052 -> 20261104103316 -> 20261104030052.
- A full redeploy is proven by the store's file on the host volume, not performed: only a restart was run. A redeploy replaces the container, and this file is outside it.
- Final state: 18 entries written by this run were each checked with get(entry:n).

# Conquest of AzerothCore FAQ: connecting and reporting bugs
id: project:faq | type: project | layer: notes v20261104030052 (built 2026-11-04)
realm: coa-development (proven) | trust: derived | source: coa-development.org public page /faq (the emulator project, not Ascension) | source date: 2026-11-04

This page describes the Conquest of AzerothCore emulator project. It isn't evidence about Ascension.

## Getting started

### How do I connect to the test realm?

- Create a test account on the front page. Use the account name to log in, not your email address.

- Download the launcher from step 2 on the front page. It gets your client ready for the test realm.

- Start the game from the launcher and log in.

Playing without the launcher? Set the realmlist by hand, see the next question.

### How do I set the realmlist by hand?

- Close the game.

- Open Data\enUS\realmlist.wtf (or Data\enGB\realmlist.wtf) in your game folder with Notepad.

- Replace everything in it with this single line and save:

set realmlist YOUR.REALMLIST.HERE

If the game still goes to the wrong server, delete the Cache folder in your game folder and check that a Config.wtf in WTF does not set a different realmlist.

### Which game client do I need?

Wrath of the Lich King 3.3.5a (build 12340). The launcher adds the Conquest of AzerothCore files on top of it. Other versions cannot log in.

## Testing & bugs

### How do I report a bug?

Use Bug reports in My Account, or open an issue on the bug tracker. Say what you did, what you expected and what happened instead. Spell or quest names and screenshots help a lot.

Reports the team confirms or fixes count towards the Bug Hunter badge in the Armory.

### Is my bug already known?

Each class page lists the open issues for that class, and the changelog says what was fixed. The bug tracker has the full list.

### What is a public bug test realm?

A realm for finding problems before they reach everyone. Expect bugs, restarts and changes. Restarts are announced in the banner at the top of the site and on Discord.

Page: https://coa-development.org/faq, read 2026-11-04.
